appName.message: Better Videos for Instagram: Playback & Volume

appDescription.message: Control Instagram playback, volume, speed and picture-in-picture.

pipErrorLabel.message: Could not open PiP. Play the video and try again.

extensionEnabledDescription.message: Enabled for Instagram. Check this page’s connection below.

clickToPauseDescription.message: Pause feed videos instead of opening Reels

setupDescription.message: Open Instagram and play a video to use the controls.

openInstagramDescription.message: Visit any page with a supported video.

playVideoDescription.message: The controls appear when a video starts.

adjustPreferencesDescription.message: Change your preferences from the extension icon.

diagnosticsOpenInstagram.message: Open an Instagram tab, then check again.

diagnosticsReady.message: Video controls are connected. You can copy these details into a bug report.

diagnosticsNoControls.message: No controls are attached yet. Show a video, then check again. The details below can help with a bug report.

diagnosticsReload.message: This tab is not connected to the extension. Reload Instagram after installing or updating, and check site access in your browser settings.

clickModePauseDescription.message: Click a video to pause or resume it.

clickModePauseReelsDescription.message: Click to pause or play. Use the Reels button to open the same video in Instagram’s Reels view.

featureUpdatesDescription.message: Open what’s new for feature releases, such as 1.6.0. Bug-fix updates stay quiet.

keyboardShortcutsHint.message: Reels: Space keeps Instagram’s behavior; use K to play/pause. Feed, Story videos and PiP also accept Space for playback. Reels/Stories: ↑ / ↓ keeps native navigation; use + / − for volume. Feed/PiP also accepts ↑ / ↓ for volume. In Feed, hover or select a video first. Text fields and menus keep their keys. Photo Story PiP: ← / → switches Stories.
